pattern_name: Move readiness: unified clinical plus claims lakehouse
when_to_apply: When EMR, claims, pharmacy, and CRM data are fragmented and no cloud data platform exists, recommend phased Databricks on AWS foundation before AI scale.

pattern_name: Automation blocker: prior auth evidence retrieval
when_to_apply: Prior authorization automation should not be sold as pure AI until policy evidence, clinical context retrieval, and audit trail are machine-readable.

pattern_name: Call center: agent assist needs real-time member context
when_to_apply: Agent assist value depends on joining transcripts, CRM, benefits, claims, prior auth, and care gaps with low latency.

pattern_name: Provider quality: HEDIS/STAR attribution before dashboards
when_to_apply: Provider performance dashboards are trusted only when attribution, measure closure, denominator logic, and audit trail are certified.

pattern_name: Finance: cost-of-care requires claims + contracts + GL grain
when_to_apply: Cost transparency requires joining claims, capitation, provider contracts, product, population, and GL without losing traceability.

pattern_name: Payment integrity: pattern library needs feedback loop
when_to_apply: Payment integrity improves only when claim anomaly features, provider pattern history, investigation outcomes, and recovery feedback are reused.

pattern_name: Automated close: claims accrual and provider contract evidence
when_to_apply: Automated close must reconcile claims accruals, capitation, provider contracts, GL, and management reporting with source citations.
